rules.rule: A change in behavior can make pages false that it does not touch ("Changes That Reach Several Pages" in AGENTS.md). When a PR changes what a config field, CLI flag, or Helm value does, search docs/ for it and flag each page outside the diff that still describes the old behavior. When a PR adds a database engine or queue service, flag each list of its siblings it is missing from, including its row in docs/reference/feature-matrix.md, the lists in docs/sharing-the-cluster/queue-splitting.md, and, for an engine with a default branch image, the default images table in docs/managing-mirrord/operator.md. Some lists name only a few siblings, so search for several of them.
